notes.title: Amazing Space is Looking for Playtesters!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that [i]Amazing Space[/i] is on the lookout for dedicated playtesters! This is your chance to get an exclusive early look at our game and help us refine it before launch.

[h2]What We're Looking For:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Curious explorers[/b] ready to dive into the vast reaches of space.
[*][b]Feedback enthusiasts[/b] eager to help us improve the game.
[*][b]Committed players[/b] willing to test new features and assist us in polishing the experience.
[/list]

[h2]How to Join:[/h2]
➡️ Simply send us a [url=https://discord.gg/DfXh7Q9FN5]message on Discord[/url] to become part of our testing community!  
Our Discord server is the perfect place to ask questions, provide feedback, and connect directly with our development team.

We can't wait to hear from you and explore the universe of [i]Amazing Space[/i] together! 🌌

Thank you for your support, and see you soon among the stars! 🚀

[b]Playbosh[/b]
